layouts.name: Carver Barracks
layouts.description: The venue operator identifies the approximately 1.5-mile runway circuit at former RAF Debden. The supplied configuration identifies the short northern cross-runway, eastern main runway, southern perimeter return and curved western perimeter. Independent Environment Agency 2018 one-metre LiDAR intensity imagery locates those permanent surfaces. The northern airfield hairpin, long westward runway, base access and temporary cone chicanes are excluded. The independently measured 2,205.7 m differs from the supplied 2,247 m; it is not scaled. Exact survey grids, member names, source hashes, crop transform and nearest-neighbor reprojection are pinned. This is reflected laser intensity, not colour photography. Racing-line placement, temporary event furniture and historical correspondence remain draft. Private timing data does not determine geometry. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 2205.7 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
